mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4.5% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financial conditions compressing near-term discounting of equity cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the current month
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window following the trigger, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-trigger mean (p > 0.1), or the 5-day moving average of FEDFUNDS does not revert below 4.5% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL inflation index falls by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be positive as investors anticipate a pause or reversal in rate hikes.
failure_condition: Across 10 consecutive such inflation declines, the 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or the 5-day moving average of CPIAUCSL does not revert to the prior month's level within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) of at least 2,000 jobs over three consecutive months predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as strong labor demand supports corporate optimism and equity valuation expansion.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 2,000 over the past three months
failure_condition: In regimes where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for the next 60 days, the 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (p > 0.05), or the 3-month moving average of PAYEMS does not revert below the trigger level within 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDPC1 (goods orders) and HOUST (housing starts) show double-digit month-over-month growth in the same quarter, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to over-heating demand signals triggering a correction in valuation.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 % change > +10% AND HOUST % change > +10% in the same quarter
failure_condition: Over 5 such compound demand spikes, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of cases (binomial test p > 0.4), or the 5-day moving average of both GDPC1 and HOUST decays below the trigger levels within 15 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) by at least 2% month-over-month, while UNRATE remains below 5%, predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing output signals a risk-off environment.
failure_condition: Across 10 such contraction events, the 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.1), or UNRATE rises above 5% within 10 days post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months in a labor market cooling regime, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is expected to be positive as lower wage growth supports lower equity risk premia.
failure_condition: In 5 such cooling episodes, the 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or the 3-month moving average of UNRATE does not exceed 4% within 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in RSAFS (money supply growth) below -1% for three consecutive months in a deflationary regime is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as reduced liquidity dampens market activity.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly % change < -1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: During 8 such deflationary episodes, the 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.1), or the 5-day moving average of RSAFS recovers above -1% within 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in PAYEMS and GDPC1 (both rising by at least 3,000 and 5%, respectively) in a non-inflationary regime predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as strong demand supports near-term corporate earnings optimism.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS +3,000 AND GDPC1 +5% in the current month
failure_condition: Across 10 such events, the 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or either PAYEMS or GDPC1 reverts to neutral growth within 5 days.
